You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a simple state machine with four variables: node activity status, node colors, a token position, and a token color. It defines type constraints over a small node set and a two-color domain, initializes the state nondeterministically subject to some constraints, and defines a next-state relation that similarly chooses a successor state subject to constraints. The temporal property asserted is a standard behavior specification requiring that behaviors start in Init and thereafter satisfy the stuttering-closed next-state formula [][Next]_vars; there are no fairness conditions, fault assumptions, or proof obligations in this file.
